seo.title: Home — Empowering youth, transforming communities
seo.description: WAHHF Foundation supports young people and vulnerable communities in Cameroon: education, health, entrepreneurship, environment and mobility towards Europe.

hero.intro: WAHHF Foundation supports young people and vulnerable communities in Cameroon: education, health, entrepreneurship, environment and mobility towards Europe.
hero.equipe: A team between Cameroon and Germany
hero.pays: European countries we guide young people towards

qsn.texte: WAHHF Foundation is the social branch of the IROKO Group. Based in Yaoundé and Douala, with coordination in Germany, it supports young people towards autonomy: education, health, entrepreneurship, environment, rights and inclusion, and mobility towards Europe.

dignite.texte: Every young person shapes their own path.

gratuite.texte: The German and English academy, from A1 to C1, at no cost.

chiffres.note: Impact figures (young people supported, activities carried out) will be published here as soon as they are dated and verified.

domaines.consigne: Scroll to explore the 6 areas · WAHHF Foundation

parcours.texte: Young people tell, in their own words, what they have built with the foundation.
parcours.vierge: And you? Your journey can encourage other young people.

appel.texte: Have you taken part in one of the foundation’s programmes? Tell us about your journey: with your consent, it can encourage other young people.

niveaux.sousTexte: From A1 to C1, free of charge

villes.sousTexte: Our teams in Yaoundé and Douala, with coordination in Germany

wahhf-on-wheel.texte: Our mobile clinic travels through the most remote areas of Cameroon to offer free primary care: consultations, vaccinations, screenings and hygiene awareness.

jalons.libelle: young people trained in community health

academie.texte: A free programme for learning German and English, from level A1 to level C1, with verified guidance pages for 10 European countries.

marie.citation: WAHHF’s mentoring gave me the confidence and the tools to start my food-processing business.
marie.resume: From urban farming to setting up her micro-business, Marie followed the mentoring programme for 12 months.

evenements.intro: Days to meet the foundation, its teams and partners.
evenements.bientot: The next event will be announced very soon

don.texte: Your donation supports our work in Cameroon across our six areas: education, health, youth entrepreneurship, environment, rights and inclusion, mobility and languages. You choose the area you want to support, or you let the foundation allocate it where the need is most urgent.
don.confiance: The IROKO Group covers our running and teaching costs.

devenir.texte: Companies, schools, associations, local authorities: let’s build pathways together for young people in Cameroon.
